about_the_game:
A last-minute vacation. A lonely landlady. A week where every boundary will be shattered.

When a family trip is suddenly cancelled, you make a spur-of-the-moment decision to take your father's place, accompanying your beautiful and mature landlady on a week-long vacation escape. What starts as a simple favor quickly ignites into a journey of shared secrets, forbidden temptations, and undeniable chemistry.

She's been taken for granted one too many times, and her loneliness is a palpable thing beneath her composed exterior. Away from the prying eyes of your everyday life, the sun-drenched days and intimate hotel nights create a space where rules blur and inhibitions melt away. Will you be her confidant, her protector, or will you seize the opportunity to become the man she truly desires?

This is a choice-driven adult visual novel where your decisions forge an unforgettable, passionate affair. Through conversation, subtle gestures, and bold actions, you will navigate a week of intense emotional and physical escalation. From helping her with sunscreen on the beach to comforting her in a moment of vulnerability, every interaction is a chance to deepen your connection or push it into uncharted, steamy territory.

Witness a complex and realistic story of temptation unfold, where gratitude mixes with attraction and loneliness fuels a search for affection. Your choices will determine just how far you both are willing to go when no one is watching.

Will you be the one who finally gives her the attention she craves? The choice is yours. Make this a vacation she will never forget.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not appropriate for all ages, or for viewing at work: sexual content, nudity and usage of drugs. The game graphically depicts sex. All characters in the game are over the age of 18.
